Only an optional test correction was found in the reviewed scope: the legacy-header test passes without exercising header validation. This review read both changed files and all repository tests; the separate complete-report test covers unsupported-version rejection. No tests were run.

## Changes

## Suggestions
- tests/test_report.py:10 — tests — Give the legacy-header test a complete v0 report — For the constructed input `REPORT v1\nversion=v0`, the assertion passes because the report lacks `END`. The replacement changes the payload’s version, leaving the header at `REPORT v1`, and the parser returns before reaching header validation. — This test cannot detect the version-validation defect it claims to guard, although the separate complete-report test provides that regression coverage. — Fix: Use `REPORT v0\nversion=v1\nEND`, or remove the redundant test.
